$comment: Checked in, unlike settings.local.json, because the guardrail is a property of the
repository rather than of one developer's machine. core/governance/agent_guardrails.py
spent its whole life with zero call sites; this registration is what gives it one.
It stops a mistake, not an intent -- real containment is an OS jail, a read-only mount,
or credentials that cannot perform the action. See .claude/hooks/guardrails.py.
